CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fep.reject_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'fep'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEP_APPEND_ONLY'; END $function$
